title: Nvidia is the central bank of AI
summary: This article analyzes Nvidia's dominant position in the AI chip market, comparing it to a central bank's control over monetary policy. Nvidia controls approximately 80% of the AI accelerator market and has built a powerful ecosystem with CUDA that creates strong customer lock-in, giving it unprecedented leverage over the entire AI supply chain similar to how central banks influence economies.
problem_solved: Explains why Nvidia has become the critical bottleneck and power player in the rapidly growing AI industry.
why_valuable: It reveals the economic power dynamics and strategic positioning that make Nvidia indispensable to AI development, offering insights into tech industry power structures.
